author: AmmarAlBalkhi
method: Five fresh working-agent trials on isolated fixtures. Expected outcomes were withheld. File changes were independently checked against pre-trial SHA-256 snapshots. Response summaries omit machine-specific paths and agent-run identifiers.
limits: Subagent unavailability was simulated by prohibiting reviewer tools on a subagent-capable host.
Each case ran once in one environment using a local candidate copy. This does not establish behavior on every agent or CLI.
Earlier behavioral cases were not all rerun. A same-session review does not supply independent judgment.
